description_en: Retrieves the current billable storage usage and subscription purchase volume for threat analysis. Units are in GB
description_zh: 获取当前威胁分析存储的使用量以及预付费的购买量，单位为GB
name: GetCapacity

parameters.help_en:
View type.

0: View for the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: View for all accounts under your enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: User ID of the member whose view the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
Region where the Data Management Center for threat analysis is located. Choose a region based on where your assets are located.

cn-hangzhou: Select this if your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

ap-southeast-1: Select this if your assets are outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港，选择该项。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域，选择该项
parameters.name: region_id

ExistLogStore.description_en:
Indicates whether the LogStore for threat analysis exists.

true: Logs are normal and log analysis is available.

false: Logs are being cleaned up and log analysis is unavailable
ExistLogStore.description_zh:
威胁分析用户侧LogStore是否存在。取值：
true：当前日志正常，日志分析可用
false：当前正在清理日志，日志分析不可用
ExistLogStore.title_zh:
威胁分析用户侧LogStore是否存在，默认true。取值：
true：当前日志正常，日志分析可用
false：当前正在清理日志，日志分析不可用

PreservedCapacity.description_en: Purchased storage capacity for threat analysis, in GB
PreservedCapacity.description_zh: 威胁分析用户购买容量（GB）
PreservedCapacity.title_zh: 威胁分析用户购买容量。

UsedCapacity.description_en: Current billable storage usage for threat analysis, in GB
UsedCapacity.description_zh: 威胁分析当前计费容量（GB）
UsedCapacity.title_zh: 威胁分析当前计费容量。
